steps.name: wait for the save to finish loading
build the mansion: walls, doors, floors, roof, beds, table, lamps, a storage room with shelves
steps.eval: local m = game.maps.current() local x0, z0, w, h = 130, 118, 17, 13 local fails = {} local function try(f, ...) local ok, e = pcall(f, ...) if not ok then fails[#fails + 1] = tostring(e):sub(1, 50) end return ok end local function wall(x, z) try(game.build.instant, m, "Wall", x, z, { stuff = "WoodLog" }) end local function door(x, z) try(game.build.instant, m, "Door", x, z, { stuff = "WoodLog" }) end local function floor(x, z, d) if not try(game.maps.set_terrain, m, x, z, d) then pcall(game.maps.set_terrain, m, x, z, "WoodPlankFloor") end end for x = x0, x0 + w - 1 do   for z = z0, z0 + h - 1 do     local edge = x == x0 or x == x0 + w - 1 or z == z0 or z == z0 + h - 1     local inner = (x == x0 + 6 or x == x0 + 11) and not edge     if edge or inner then       if (x == x0 + 8 and z == z0) or (inner and z == z0 + 4) then door(x, z) else wall(x, z) end     else       floor(x, z, x < x0 + 6 and "WoodPlankFloor" or "TileSandstone")     end   end end for x = x0, x0 + w - 1 do for z = z0, z0 + h - 1 do pcall(game.maps.set_roof, m, x, z, "RoofConstructed") end end for _, b in ipairs({ { 132, 121 }, { 134, 121 }, { 132, 125 }, { 134, 125 }, { 132, 128 }, { 134, 128 } }) do try(game.build.instant, m, "Bed", b[1], b[2], { rotation = 0 }) end try(game.build.instant, m, "Table2x2c", 137, 123, { stuff = "WoodLog" }) for _, c in ipairs({ { 136, 123, 1 }, { 139, 123, 3 }, { 137, 122, 0 }, { 138, 125, 2 } }) do try(game.build.instant, m, "DiningChair", c[1], c[2], { stuff = "WoodLog", rotation = c[3] }) end for _, l in ipairs({ { 137, 120 }, { 137, 128 }, { 133, 123 }, { 143, 123 } }) do try(game.build.instant, m, "TorchLamp", l[1], l[2]) end local shelves = 0 for i = 0, 3 do   for j = 0, 1 do     local ok, s = pcall(game.build.instant, m, "Shelf", 142 + i, 121 + j * 4, { stuff = "WoodLog", rotation = 0 })     if ok then shelves = shelves + 1 pcall(function() s:set_storage_priority("Critical") end) else fails[#fails + 1] = "Shelf " .. tostring(s):sub(1, 40) end   end end return "mansion built, shelves=" .. shelves .. ", problems=" .. #fails .. " " .. table.concat(fails, " | ")

steps.name: the mansion has rooms
steps.eval: local m = game.maps.current() local rooms = {} for _, r in ipairs(game.maps.rooms(m)) do if r.cells >= 8 and r.cells < 150 then rooms[#rooms + 1] = r.role .. ":" .. r.cells end end return "rooms=" .. table.concat(rooms, ",")
